mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation_turn (id, conversation_id, plugin_id, user_id, round, role, content, status, create_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{conversationId}, #{pluginId}, #{userId}, #{round}, #{role}, #{content}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'current' AND role = 'assistant' ORDER BY round ASC
SELECT MAX(round) FROM ai_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation_turn SET status = 'draft' WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND round >= #{round} AND status != 'published'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_conversation_turn WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND round >= #{round}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation_turn SET status = #{status}, plugin_id = #{pluginId} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_conversation_turn WHERE plugin_id = #{pluginId} AND status = 'published' ORDER BY round DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT conversation_id FROM ai_conversation_turn WHERE user_id = #{userId}
